definitions.usage: bow self, (make) crooked., falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down.
definitions.full: H5791. avath [ עָוַת ] verb be bent, crooked (Late Hebrew id. , Pi`el, Nithpa`el; Aramaic עַוֵּית Pa`el; compare , deceive PS 3008 ); — Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular suffix עִוְּתָ֑נִי Job 19:6 , עִוְּתוֺ Eccl 7:13 ; 3 plural suffix עִוְּתוּנִי Psa 119:78 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְעַוֵּת 146:9 ; Job 8:3 , יְעַוֶּתֿ 8:3 ; Infinitive לְעַוֵּת Amos 8:5 ; Lam 3:22 ; — 1. a. make crooked = falsify, scales Amos 8:5 ; pervert justice ( צֶדֶק מִשְׁמָּט, ) Job 8:3 (twice in verse); 34:12 (all God subject); with accusative of person subvert (i.e. deprive of justice), ׳לְע בְּרִיבוֺ אָדָם Lam 3:36 , compare Psa 119:78 ; so עִוְּתָ֑נִי Job 19:6 ( ׳י subject). 2 bend, make crooked , רְשָׁעִים דֶּרֶךְ Psa 146:9 ( ׳י subject); in General Eccl 7:13 (God subject; opposed to תִּקֵּן ). Pu`al Participle מְעֻוָּת Eccl 1:15 what is bent (opposed to תְּקֹן ). Hithpa`el Perfect 3plural consecutive וְהִתְעַוְּתוּ Eccl 12:3 and the strong men bend themselves .
